decisions.reason: As a recently launched service in a large German telecommunications firm, the cloud contact centre offer is close to the firm’s digital business and the recent investment can still be justified as needing more time, so management is likely to persist despite only moderate public commitment.

Because the call number routing platform had its own webpage, the firm has made a more visible public commitment to a product that fits its core telecom capabilities, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
